## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 80 captures during March 2023. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 80 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.2 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the site’s overall imaging performance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results from the captures completed at Oakridge Primary Care. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during March 2023, while the referable results require the usual follow-up arrangements. The site should continue to review image quality alongside grading outcomes, with particular attention to the 5 ungradable captures and any recurring camera issues.
